manifest.evaluation_thinking_controls: Reasoning effort low when thinking enabled; none with --no-think. isolated_eval.py supplies none to avoid conflicting API parameters.

telemetry.scope: Four-node launches initiated after the second Node3 recovery; earlier performance runs do not have this continuous telemetry.

manifest.note: The Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 campaign (2026-10-05): every template is the DFlash2 drafter with drawn proposals (engine.mtp_draft_temperature 0.7) on the graph engine, after the sampled-walk and GEMV-staging changes of the same day; the other deployments' numbers are the earlier campaigns'. The campaign configs are the templates without `http` (the runner expects :18080) and without `model_alias` (the runner matches the served id to the checkpoint id).
